quarterly_data.quarter: Jiangfeng Electronic Materials half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results (half-year report): revenue RMB 2.74 billion, up 30.68% from RMB 2.09 billion; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 539.69 million, up 113.61% from RMB 252.65 million; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 205.98 million, up 17.15%. Non-recurring gains totalled RMB 333.71 million, including RMB 262.68 million from disposals of non-current assets; investment income of RMB 296.56 million came mainly from selling part of its stake in associate Shanghai Runping, equity-method income and fair-value remeasurement. Operating cash flow RMB 328.78 million (+17.94%); asset impairment RMB 129.56 million, mainly inventory write-downs; contract liabilities rose to RMB 186.49 million from RMB 14.06 million at end-2025, mainly on higher advance receipts from customers.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue RMB 2.74 billion (+30.68%); net profit RMB 539.69 million (+113.61%); recurring net profit RMB 205.98 million (+17.15%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Jiangfeng Electronic Materials half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue by product (half-year report): ultra-high-purity sputtering targets RMB 1.67 billion, up 26.08%, gross margin 31.77% (-1.49 points); semiconductor precision parts RMB 645.04 million, up 40.59%, gross margin 23.97% (+0.32 points), with showerheads, vacuum valves, heaters and modules ramping; other RMB 421.53 million, up 35.64%, gross margin 33.57%. Domestic sales RMB 1.93 billion (+43.47%, gross margin 28.96%); overseas RMB 804.09 million (+7.61%, gross margin 33.21%). The company says demand from AI compute, memory and logic chips kept growing, downstream wafer capacity kept expanding, it kept raising its share in advanced-process products and orders from domestic and overseas customers kept increasing. R&D spending RMB 158.96 million (+33.59%); at June 30, 2026 it held 1,048 valid domestic patents, including 589 invention patents.
quarterly_data.figure: targets RMB 1.67 billion (+26.08%, 31.77% GM); precision parts RMB 645.04 million (+40.59%, 23.97% GM); R&D RMB 158.96 million (+33.59%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Jiangfeng Electronic Materials half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity projects (half-year report): the Huanghu target smart-factory buildings for the raised-fund target project were completed as planned, some workshops delivered and the core modules finished unit testing; main construction of the Korea target plant is under way; the company is accelerating construction and expansion of its electrostatic chuck, brittle-materials and showerhead projects. Raised-fund projects: the Ningbo project for 5.2 ten-thousand targets per year is 91.13% invested and its ready-for-use date was postponed from June 30, 2026 to December 31, 2027; the line upgrade for 1.8 ten-thousand targets per year (12.10%) and the R&D center (38.56%) were postponed to April 30, 2028; the 2025 placement projects - 5,100 electrostatic chucks per year (RMB 99,790 ten-thousand committed, 3.10% invested), 12,300 ultra-high-purity targets per year (RMB 25,600 ten-thousand, 13.66%) and the Shanghai R&D and technical service center (RMB 9,992.9 ten-thousand, 0.00%) - are due June 30, 2028. Construction in progress rose to RMB 1.74 billion from RMB 1.43 billion, including RMB 213.36 million of equipment under installation and commissioning; the Hangzhou Ruisheng plant was 58.20% invested.
quarterly_data.figure: 5.2 ten-thousand targets/yr project due December 31, 2027 (91.13% invested); 5,100 electrostatic chucks/yr and 12,300 targets/yr projects due June 30, 2028
